HARBOR LANTERN GRILL - Lunch

Grilled Chicken Plate - herb-marinated chicken breast, jasmine rice, steamed broccoli, olive oil. 540 cal, 46g protein, 52g carbs, 14g fat

Cheddar Burger - beef patty, aged cheddar, brioche bun, lettuce, tomato, house sauce. 820 cal, 41g protein, 58g carbs, 46g fat

Salmon Rice Bowl - seared salmon, brown rice, edamame, cucumber, sesame dressing. 610 cal, 38g protein, 60g carbs, 22g fat

Garden Salad - mixed greens, tomato, cucumber, balsamic vinaigrette. 180 cal, 4g protein, 16g carbs, 12g fat

SAFFRON TABLE - Dinner menu

Butter Chicken - chicken thigh simmered in tomato, butter and cream sauce, basmati rice. 780 cal, 44g protein, 70g carbs, 34g fat

Chana Masala - chickpeas, tomato, onion, ginger, garlic, spices, served with rice. 520 cal, 17g protein, 88g carbs, 11g fat

Tandoori Chicken - yogurt-free dry rub, charred in the clay oven, with grilled vegetables. 430 cal, 52g protein, 12g carbs, 18g fat

Palak Paneer - spinach and paneer cheese in a creamy sauce, basmati rice. 690 cal, 28g protein, 64g carbs, 36g fat

Mango Lassi - yogurt, mango, sugar. 260 cal, 7g protein, 46g carbs, 5g fat

BLUE DOOR TAQUERIA

Chicken Burrito - grilled chicken, rice, pinto beans, shredded Monterey Jack cheese, sour cream, flour tortilla. 910 cal, 49g protein, 94g carbs, 36g fat

Fish Tacos (3) - grilled cod, cabbage slaw, lime crema, corn tortillas. 480 cal, 32g protein, 45g carbs, 19g fat

Veggie Fajitas - peppers, onion, zucchini, guacamole, corn tortillas. 450 cal, 11g protein, 62g carbs, 19g fat

KETTLE & CRUMB CAFE - Breakfast

Egg White Wrap - egg whites, spinach, roasted tomato, whole wheat wrap. 320 cal, 24g protein, 36g carbs, 8g fat

Buttermilk Pancakes - three pancakes made with buttermilk, maple syrup, whipped butter. 710 cal, 14g protein, 108g carbs, 24g fat

Oatmeal Bowl - steel-cut oats cooked in water, blueberries, walnuts, brown sugar. 390 cal, 10g protein, 62g carbs, 13g fat

Turkey Sausage Scramble - eggs, turkey sausage, peppers, home fries. 560 cal, 38g protein, 34g carbs, 29g fat

PINE STREET NOODLE HOUSE

Beef Pho - rice noodles, sliced beef, bone broth, herbs, bean sprouts. 480 cal, 33g protein, 60g carbs, 9g fat

Pad Thai with Shrimp - rice noodles, shrimp, egg, peanuts, tamarind sauce. 690 cal, 31g protein, 82g carbs, 25g fat

Creamy Tom Kha Soup - chicken in coconut milk broth with galangal and mushrooms. 410 cal, 26g protein, 14g carbs, 28g fat

Chicken Alfredo Udon - udon noodles, chicken, parmesan cream sauce. 870 cal, 45g protein, 88g carbs, 38g fat

Steamed Edamame - sea salt. 120 cal, 11g protein, 9g carbs, 5g fat
